bullets.text: In Ambattur, a 25-year-old motorist died after falling into an open stormwater drain pit, prompting sharp criticism from EPS over administrative negligence.
In Tiruvallur, a student was arrested near Periyapalayam for attempting to set a woman ablaze after she rejected his advances.
The Collector warned Tiruvallur fishermen not to venture into the sea today due to a low-pressure area forming in the Bay of Bengal.
Chennai released the draft electoral roll for 2027 showing an increase to 29.14 lakh voters, with Velachery recording the highest number of additions.
The Tamil Nadu government announced the establishment of 12 mini taluk offices in Chennai to improve residents' access to revenue services.
PMK president Anbumani Ramadoss accused senior officials of favoring real estate developers in the Pallikaranai marshland case.
Commuters in Tiruvallur expressed anger as government buses have reportedly resumed collecting excess fares.
The Adani Foundation installed 90 solar-powered streetlights across nine villages and coastal settlements near the Pasiyavaram Bridge.
Chief Minister Vijay inaugurated the CapitaLand Data Centre in Chennai, boosting the state's digital infrastructure capacity.
The Tamil Nadu CB-CID filed a chargesheet against a man accused of creating deepfake videos of Chief Minister Vijay to mislead the public.
The Tamil Nadu Cyber Crime Wing busted an illegal SIM box operation in Saidapet, arresting two persons following inputs from the Department of Telecommunications.
Media discussions raised questions regarding whether the honeymoon period has ended for Chief Minister C Joseph Vijay's government six months into its term.
An AI-generated fake history book scam was exposed at Periyar Arivulagam in Coimbatore, sparking a blame game between political parties.
